reason: Predecessor writer emits rawNEL and its own reader folds that line break into space, silently losing meaning. Governing no-meaning-loss requirement requires preserving the input string. Do not reproduce predecessor writer loss.
scope: Only YAML output representation of U0085 changes. Reader rawNEL handling remains native line-break normalization; explicitly escapedNEL preservesU0085. Default ECMAScript profile unchanged.

target.writerRequirement: Emit escaped U0085 (for example \u0085 or \N) within YAML quoted strings, never rawNEL; applies to every string/key position. Output whitespace/escape spelling need not equal predecessor.
target.readerRequirement: RawNEL source continues to act as a line break as in native ruamel. EscapedNEL is decoded after source normalization and remainsU0085.
